acceptance_criteria.text: Durable ETF workstream state is current and internally consistent: the plan, handoff, provider-universe document, registry counts, audit counts, and next action agree at every checkpoint.

A complete provider-audit ledger accounts for every current fallback-only adapter key exactly once, uses the approved deterministic ranking, and records issuer-specific dated source evidence, disposition, and next action.

Every provider counted as native has a concrete provider-owned holdings route, provider-specific fetch entry point, strict parsing/mapping, truthful provenance and freshness, deterministic tests, and concrete opt-in live coverage.

Every provider remaining fallback-only has a current issuer-specific audit disposition; no fallback is silently promoted through SEC data and no generic unattempted discovery note is accepted as final evidence.

All 140 providers in the starting fallback population have been processed to either a verified native promotion or a defensible dated terminal/blocked disposition, with no missing, duplicate, or stale ledger entries.

ISSUER_ADAPTER_CONFIGS, FALLBACK_ISSUER_AUDITS, native/fallback counts, native adapter ownership, deterministic tests, live-provider coverage, documentation, and the provider-audit ledger satisfy exhaustive matrix invariants.

Focused checks, the complete deterministic adapter suite, default live contracts, the complete opt-in live provider matrix, Ruff, the Docker-backed full-integration gate, and exact-SHA CI are green or any genuine external outage is narrowly evidenced without misrepresenting validation.

The feature branch is clean and synchronized at an exact reviewed SHA, durable handoff and validation records are complete, and the workstream stops at ready_for_human_review without integration, promotion, deployment, or cross-worktree mutation.

docker_ready.reason: Docker daemon is ready under the approved elevated local-socket permission.
